hero.h1Line1: Got a message that feels off?
hero.subtitle: Paste it or drop in a screenshot. Five AI agents check the words, the links and the sender, then tell you what to do next, in English or Hindi.

evidenceStrip.agentsCaption: Autonomous specialists examining every case in parallel.
evidenceStrip.recallCaption: On our 55-message test set. Zero scam bypasses.
evidenceStrip.brandsCaption: Indian banks, government portals, and courier lookalikes.
evidenceStrip.zeroStoredCaption: Zero text retention. Cryptographic hashing only.

howItWorks.heading: Five agents, one verdict
howItWorks.subtitle: Each agent does one job. The Judge weighs their evidence and tells you which side it trusted.

consolePreview.heading: Inside the investigation console
consolePreview.caption: The same screen you will use. Messages in the thread, evidence on the right.

features.heading: Built for real Indian conditions
features.subtitle: Tested against multilingual evasion tactics, WhatsApp forward chains, and rural 4G connections.
features.cardADesc: Understands Devanagari Hindi, Roman Hinglish, and phone screenshots directly.
features.cardBDesc: Inspects DNS registration records, WHOIS age, and lookalike patterns safely in an isolated sandbox.
features.cardCDesc: When polished, polite wording masks a fake phishing link, our Judge calls out the tension explicitly.
features.cardDDesc: Your personal messages and images never hit disk storage. Only anonymized hashes protect the community.

scams.heading: Scams we catch
scams.subtitle: Patterns from real Indian fraud, with the tell-tale signs.

honestNumbers.heading: Honest numbers
honestNumbers.explanation: Security tools often hide their mistakes. We publish ours openly. Measured on our 55-message test set (30 scams, 15 genuine, 10 edge cases) evaluated in October 2026.

privacy.heading: Zero-knowledge by design
privacy.messageNotStoredSub: Your text is analyzed in memory and immediately discarded. No databases retain your words.
privacy.linksNotOpenedSub: We inspect DNS and domain registry metadata without ever requesting or downloading link targets.
privacy.hashesOnly: Community reports keep only a hash.
privacy.hashesOnlySub: Reported numbers and links are irreversibly salted and hashed before joining peer defense.

footer.hackathonNote: Built for Hacktober Hack Day Prayagraj 2026.
footer.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. This is guidance, not legal or police advice.

verdict.safeSub: Matches regular non-fraud patterns. Always guard your OTP.
verdict.suspiciousSub: Exercise extreme caution. Verify independently through official channels.
verdict.scamSub: Do NOT tap any link, pay money, or reply to this message.
verdict.conflictQuote: The wording looked official, but the technical evidence says otherwise. We trusted the evidence.
verdict.mistakeWarning: AI can make mistakes. If you are unsure, do not click, and call your bank using the number on your card.
